title: Independent final-panel evaluation — owner/staff platform rescue

target.exact_tree_note: HEAD was exact and the rescue worktree was clean except intentional untracked .playwright-cli/, which was ignored. No implementation code was edited by this evaluator.

rollback.note: Coordinate before reverting a pushed/shared multi-slice commit. Merging dev to main, deploying Production, changing DNS, or mutating Production data still requires owner approval.

preserved_findings.summary: crew_member could mutate task completion and project updates contrary to the committed matrix
the assignments entity/index was absent and crew listing filtered after a bounded organization slice
the secure customer Documents workflow had no explicit customer grant/list/download path
customer onboarding, scheduling, assignment, and role mutations had no portal call sites
portal layouts did not reject a role directly opening another role's route
light-theme primary button text contrast was below WCAG 2.2 AA
terminal provisioning and route loading/error failures lacked recoverable user-facing states
the source-pack node lacked an auditable independent receipt while a downstream state claimed one existed
the origin/dev comparison failed git diff --check due to added EOF blank lines

evaluation_history.prior_verdict_rationale: The 723b5d4 candidate materially fixed PR #26 authorization findings but could not pass because its crew write contract, assignment model/query, customer Documents workflow, lifecycle UI, route guard, contrast, failure states, v4-002 governance, and diff hygiene remained incomplete.
evaluation_history.history_note: The prior remediate verdict remains part of the audit trail and is superseded only for the new immutable candidate after independent re-evaluation.

scope_and_abstention.broad_evaluator_scope: Full origin/dev comparison and the remediation delta outside the customer-document slice, including PR #26 authorization findings, WorkOS, lifecycle RPC/UI, assignments, crew writes, checklists, route guards, failure states, contrast, public prefetch, idempotency, tests, environment, dependency, and governance gates.
scope_and_abstention.abstained_slice: The evaluator implemented the customer-document slice and therefore explicitly abstained from judging its policy, specialized list/download actions, customer-document UI, and hostile customer-document tests.
scope_and_abstention.panel_reliance: The whole-candidate verdict relies on that separate commit-exact receipt for the abstained slice; this evaluator makes no independent customer-document pass claim.

verdict_rationale: Pass. The exact candidate closes every prior code and governance blocker, preserves fail-closed tenant and identity boundaries, supplies operational owner/staff lifecycle UI, aligns crew writes with the authorization matrix, adds indexed assignments and idempotent estimate-to-job creation, fixes route capability, contrast, loading/error, login/proxy, and prefetch behavior, and passes the complete 178-test/build/audit/hygiene gate. The evaluator explicitly abstained from its own customer-document slice and relied on a separate exact-SHA pass receipt with zero blockers. V4-002 is independently reproduced and passes. Remaining items are explicit external Preview/release gates, not contradictory code findings.
